title: It’s been a long journey, but just finished the reveal video for our first game, built by a small team in the UK! Do you think it's engaging enough? Always feels tough to show off a text-based game.
author: PlojOW

comments.author: PikachuDash
comments.body: Does the AI advance the storyline by itself at all or is it more roleplay heavy where the user handholds the AI more?

replies.author: PlojOW
replies.body: The AI does advance the storyline as you go through the game yes! There is no user handholding the AI in order to progress.

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body: If the video trully represents How the game plays, this will probably be the best gtrpg to date. Can't wait to try It out! Is there a way to sign up for beta or something like that?

replies.author: PlojOW
replies.body:
Yeah absolutely! Come join our discord as thats where we will be talking about our upcoming playtests or check out the website! [https://discord.gg/t7ZKabTK](https://discord.gg/t7ZKabTK)

You can even check out our recent alpha demo on YT through the discord.
